title: Scary vibes and war like vibes
content: I was in my city version of mall world last night, more like a college town less mall. I was also at a lot of transit stations looking for my siblings to make sure we all stayed together. But the vibe I got was very dark and evil. There is unrest afoot and even when I was flying close to people, I had to fly higher because their bad vibes were palpable. There was also this separation between good and bad. Felt like the whole town was splitting. But while all this was going on, all the normal stuff was happening, like movies and restaurant eating, so felt like some major distractions happening. There were also lots of gathered groups of people just waiting for something Also, things like parking lots, were in total anarchy. People parking every which way, and I knew that when we drove on the highways, we were going to have major problems getting through. Felt like sinkholes were opening up all over, lots of wrecks
